description: Production ML runtime: model readiness, observed activity, latency and three-class decisions. Latency measures the classify handler, not complete email delivery.

panels.title: Public API
panels.description: HTTP 200 and status=ok from the public /v1/health route, probed by Alloy. This is not an authenticated classification or an independent host monitor. Measurements older than 180 seconds are stale; missing telemetry is unknown.

targets.expr: ((min((probe_success{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-health"} and (timestamp(probe_success{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-health"}) > time() - 180))) or (0 * min(probe_success{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-health"}) + 2) or vector(3)) and on() (min((up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-health"} and (timestamp(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-health"}) > time() - 180))) == 1)) or ((0 * min(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-health"}) + 2) unless on() min(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-health"} and (timestamp(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-health"}) > time() - 180))) or vector(3)

panels.title: ML scrape
panels.description: Alloy scraping the internal ML /v1/metrics endpoint. Measurements older than 180 seconds are stale; missing telemetry is unknown.

panels.title: Model
panels.description: Reported ONNX model readiness, only while the inference scrape is healthy. Measurements older than 180 seconds are stale; missing telemetry is unknown.

targets.expr: ((min((sicurre_model_ready{stack="sicurre-ml"} and (timestamp(sicurre_model_ready{stack="sicurre-ml"}) > time() - 180))) or (0 * min(sicurre_model_ready{stack="sicurre-ml"}) + 2) or vector(3)) and on() (min((up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"} and (timestamp(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"}) > time() - 180))) == 1)) or ((0 * min(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"}) + 2) unless on() min(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"} and (timestamp(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"}) > time() - 180))) or vector(3)

panels.title: Alloy
panels.description: Alloy self-scrape received in Grafana. A missing collector cannot diagnose whether the application or the host is down. Measurements older than 180 seconds are stale; missing telemetry is unknown.

panels.title: Telemetry age
panels.description: Age of the oldest available sample among the inference scrape, Alloy heartbeat and HTTP probe. Inspect their individual Unknown states if a source is missing.

panels.title: Model revision
panels.description: Immutable served-model revision. Full identity is available in the series labels and deployment manifest.

targets.expr: (max by (display_version) (label_replace(sicurre_inference_model_info{stack="sicurre-ml",version=~".{19,}"}, "display_version", "$1…$2", "version", "^(.{10}).*(.{8})$")) or max by (display_version) (label_replace(sicurre_inference_model_info{stack="sicurre-ml",version=~".{0,18}"}, "display_version", "$1", "version", "^(.*)$"))) and on() (min((up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"} and (timestamp(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"}) > time() - 180))) == 1)

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Classify requests over the selected time range, calculated independently of the rolling windows used by the rate chart. Prometheus increases are estimates, not an authoritative request ledger.

panels.title: Server errors
panels.description: Estimated 5xx responses in the selected range. Zero is shown only while the scrape is healthy and the request counter is observable.

panels.title: P50 latency
panels.description: Estimated P50 for measured ML handler durations over the selected dashboard period, across modes. Not email delivery latency. Calculated from histogram buckets, not averaged percentiles. No observations means no data. Sparse samples are unstable. Histogram ceiling: 3000 ms.

panels.title: P95 latency
panels.description: Estimated P95 for measured ML handler durations over the selected dashboard period, across modes. Not email delivery latency. Calculated from histogram buckets, not averaged percentiles. No observations means no data. Sparse samples are unstable. Histogram ceiling: 3000 ms.

panels.title: Inference latency
panels.description: Estimated p50 and p95 inside the ML classify handler, over rolling observation windows. Not end-to-end email delivery. Missing observations remain gaps. Classic histogram estimates saturate at the highest finite bucket (3000 ms).

panels.title: Request activity
panels.description: Classify requests per minute, derived from a rolling window of at least two scrapes at the 60-second cadence. This is a smoothed rate, not a count of events in a bin; the range total is shown separately in the summary strip.

panels.title: Content classification
panels.description: Estimated class counts over the selected range. Content category is separate from the safety verdict; counts are not an authoritative email ledger.

panels.title: Mean stage duration
panels.description: Mean observed stage duration over the selected range. Unobserved stages are omitted. Parallel stage durations do not sum to request wall time.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: ML process CPU consumption in cores, not whole-host utilization. No arbitrary CPU alert threshold.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: ML process resident memory, not whole-host memory. Red above the existing 6 GiB alert threshold; the alert requires ten minutes.

targets.expr: max((sicurre_process_resident_memory_bytes{stack="sicurre-ml"} and (timestamp(sicurre_process_resident_memory_bytes{stack="sicurre-ml"}) > time() - 180))) and on() (min((up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"} and (timestamp(up{stack="sicurre-ml",service_name="sicurre-ml-inference"}) > time() - 180))) == 1)

panels.title: Active series / 3,000
panels.description: Current ML-stack series against its configured 3,000-series allocation. Warning above 2,100, critical above 2,550; alerts require 15 minutes. Not the whole shared Grafana tenant quota.

panels.title: Non-2xx responses by status
panels.description: Non-2xx responses grouped by HTTP status over rolling windows. Absence of a series means no such response was recorded, which is only meaningful when the request-rate panel shows traffic and the scrape is fresh.

panels.title: LLM provider outcomes
panels.description: Bounded provider outcomes — selection, timeout, invalid response, and chain unavailability — rather than a share of which provider answered. Separates 'a provider was chosen' from 'a provider succeeded'. Series appear only once the counter has been incremented at least once.

panels.title: Authentication and rate-limit rejections
panels.description: Requests refused before classification. Rate limiting is configured at 1 request/second sustained with a burst of 5.

panels.title: Runtime errors
panels.description: Runtime error counts by bounded reason.

panels.title: Latency by requested mode
panels.description: Estimated p95 per requested mode. LLM mode includes the provider chain; local mode skips it. Runtime timeout configuration is recorded in the deployment manifest.

panels.title: Final verdict volume
panels.description: Composite verdicts returned to the caller over rolling windows.

panels.title: Degraded decisions
panels.description: Estimated decisions with a recorded degradation reason. Zero requires a healthy scrape and an observable request counter.

panels.title: Process memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the inference process. The deployed alert pages above 6 GiB.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds consumed per second, i.e. cores in use.

title: Sicurre ML / Inference
